name: Memory fallback discipline
specNote: STAND-IN, not a recovered original requirement. No authoritative Stage 4 Task 2 exists in the current materials. Designated by the project owner on 2026-09-28 from the existing full-tests.json case tools-memory-fallback.
prompt: Search memories for the deliberately absent phrase JARVIS_REGRESSION_MISSING_9F31. If search returns nothing, use list_memories as the fallback. Do not invent a memory. Say which tools you used.
expectedBehavior: Call search_memories, receive no match, then call list_memories. State that no matching memory was found and identify both tools. No data or configuration changes.
postconditions: No memory, file, model, prompt, or configuration state is changed
